intake: Only exact outputs of completed paid operations; external uptake requires public scoped content or an actual event naming the recipient. Private bindings cannot be given away as knowledge.
facets: Native last realized element is the emitted aspect. Receiver facet cap is exact Model A position intersection. Empty intersection cannot enter kept state.
handoff: Actual A5 event uptake -> paid A6 Organize -> paid A1 Understand for IEE, in both settings; exact native objects, both supplied and retained operands consumed by the last operation.
audit: Independent raw journal reconstruction of source output, actual route, typed intermediate predecessor chain, paid threshold, exact receipt and later consumer; no selector/executor/scheduler imports.
gate: 64 completed paid route/polarity cells with downstream consumers; two actual handoff chains and all named controls enforce their stated constraints. Unmet semantics are failures, never relabeled.
